dx_raw:
DIAGNOSOMA: Meige syndrome (idiopathic cranial segmental dystonia affecting blephal, perioral, and oromandibular muscles)

Differential considerations:

1. Secondary cranial dystonia (drug-induced or post-traumatic)
2. Hemifacial spasm (if predominantly unilateral)
3. Tardive oromandibular dystonia (if history of neuroleptic/antiemetic use)
